verdict.rationale: Remote documents an official MCP server. An agent client can query live workforce data through it, for example "How many people do we have in Portugal?", and it also offers write tools for employee self-service actions. The core of the story is delivered, but the documentation is thin beyond these examples. Missing for 10: documented connection and auth setup steps for the MCP endpoint, write tools beyond employee self-service, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: It reads the question, fetches the answer from Remote through the MCP, and replies from your live data.
Write tools (employee self-service, available today): Submit time off requests; Update personal details, home address, emergency contact
